verdict.rationale: Google documents official Gemini API Skills for coding assistants such as Antigravity, Claude Code and Cursor, which inject current SDK patterns into the agent's context. It also ships a first-party GenAI SDK for Python, JS/TS, Go and Java, plus OpenAI-library compatibility that lets OpenAI-based agent tooling call Gemini with about three lines changed. These skills mainly help agents write Gemini code rather than run Gemini as the agent's model. Missing for 10: documented first-party integrations with named agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain-style connectors or plugins), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the skills and integrations work in practice.
